fields.hook: From bifold to Ridge wallet: order it, move the cards over, decide by day 99 from the order.
fields.reason_1: Day 1: the order. The 99 days start here.
fields.reason_2: When it arrives: move the cards over. Keep the old wallet.
fields.reason_3: By day 99 from the order: keep it, exchange it, or start a return.
fields.offer_line: Start a return within 99 days of the order. Not for personalized, warranty-claim or certain limited-edition items. Ridge return terms as of 23 October 2026; they can change.
